name: Takasaki Kaoru
source:
The main character's best friend. He is basically an idiot, but he has a bright and refreshing personality. 

He often makes fun of the main character, but only in a joking manner, and has saved the main character from being bullied many times.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_kyousi.htm]official site[/url]]
